text: Sensitive means something bothers you more than it bothers most people. Some kids are sensitive to loud noises.
To donate is to give something away for free to help others. Neighbors donated items for the bags.
Something inspiring makes you want to do something good too.
A fidget spinner is a small toy that spins in your fingers. It can help a person feel calm.
LGM stands for Ledger Greyson Mann. It is the name of Ledger's bags.
Virginia is a state on the east side of the United States.
Autism is a way some people's brains work. It can change how a person learns, plays, and talks.
First responders are people who rush to help in an emergency. Police officers and firefighters are first responders.
A sergeant is a police officer with a higher rank, who helps lead other officers.
A police department is the group of police officers who keep a town or county safe.
Prince George County is a place in Virginia. Ledger lives there.
Missing means lost, and nobody knows where the person is.
To distribute means to hand things out to many people.
Florida is a warm state in the southeast of the United States.
Maryland is a state on the east coast of the United States.
West Virginia is a state in the eastern United States, with many hills.
Firefighters are people whose job is to put out fires and help in emergencies.
Paramedics are medical workers who ride in ambulances and help people who are hurt or sick.
Motivation is the reason you want to do something.
When a doctor diagnoses something, the doctor figures out what a person has.
ASD means autism spectrum disorder. It is the full name for autism.
A condition is a health matter that a person lives with.
To communicate is to share your thoughts with others, by talking or in other ways.
Nonverbal means not using spoken words. Some people use boards or pictures to share their thoughts.
A dry erase board is a white board you can write on and then wipe clean.
Comforting means making you feel safe and calm.
Ginormous is a silly word. It means giant and enormous at once.
A piggy bank is a small container, often shaped like a pig, where you save coins.
An organization is a group of people who work together for a goal.
Stepped up means came forward to help when help was needed.
A community is the people who live near one another, like your neighbors.
Jiujitsu is a sport where people learn moves to wrestle and stay safe.
Quality control means checking that things are made well. Ledger checks each bag.
Ulster County is a place in New York State.
New York is a state in the northeast of the United States.
An ambulance is a truck that takes hurt or sick people to the hospital.
Leadership means showing others the way and helping them follow.
The County Executive is the leader who runs a county.
Service means helping other people.
Crystal clear means very easy to see or understand.
To promote something is to help more people know about it and want it.
Wellness means being healthy in your body and mind.
